questions.domain: Domain 5: 安全性、合规与管控
questions.question: An AI practitioner trained a custom model on Amazon Bedrock by using a training dataset that contains confidential data. The AI practitioner wants to ensure that the custom model does not generate inference responses based on confidential data. How should the AI practitioner prevent responses based on confidential data?
questions.question_zh: 一名 AI 从业者在 Amazon Bedrock 上使用包含机密数据的训练数据集训练了一个自定义模型。该从业者希望确保该模型在推理时不会基于机密数据生成回复。应该如何防止基于机密数据生成响应？
options: Delete the custom model. Remove the confidential data from the training dataset. Retrain the custom model.
Mask the confidential data in the inference responses by using dynamic data masking.
Encrypt the confidential data in the inference responses by using Amazon SageMaker.
Encrypt the confidential data in the custom model by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS).
options_zh: 删除该自定义模型。从训练数据集中移除机密数据。重新训练自定义模型。
使用动态数据脱敏技术对推理响应中的机密数据进行掩码。
使用 Amazon SageMaker 对推理响应中的机密数据进行加密。
使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 加密自定义模型中的机密数据。
questions.rationale:
【核心考点：模型机密数据泄露防范】
当模型在包含机密或敏感数据的数据集上完成训练后，其权重可能已经隐式学习或记忆了该机密信息。彻底确保模型不产生机密推理的唯一方法是：删除该模型，清洗数据源，并从头重新训练。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: Which feature of Amazon OpenSearch Service gives companies the ability to build vector database applications?
questions.question_zh: Amazon OpenSearch Service 的哪项功能使企业能够构建向量数据库应用程序？
options: Integration with Amazon S3 for object storage
Support for geospatial indexing and queries
Scalable index management and nearest neighbor search capability
Ability to perform real-time analysis on streaming data
options_zh: 与 Amazon S3 集成进行对象存储
支持地理空间索引和查询
可扩展的索引管理以及近邻搜索能力
对流式数据执行实时分析的能力
questions.rationale:
【核心考点：向量数据库与检索增强生成 RAG】
Amazon OpenSearch Service 支持 k-最近邻 (k-NN) 算法与可扩展的向量索引管理，允许对生成式 AI 产生的高维向量嵌入 (Embeddings) 进行语义相似度搜索。

questions.domain: Domain 2: 生成式 AI 的基础知识
questions.question: A company wants to display the total sales for its top-selling products across various retail locations in the past 12 months. Which AWS solution should the company use to automate the generation of graphs?

options_zh: Amazon EC2 中的 Amazon Q
Amazon Q Developer
Amazon QuickSight 中的 Amazon Q
AWS Chatbot 中的 Amazon Q

Amazon Q in QuickSight 允许业务人员直接输入自然语言问题，系统自动理解数据结构并生成可视化图表、执行摘要与数据故事。

questions.domain: Domain 4: 负责任 AI 的指南
questions.question: A company wants to build an interactive application for children that generates new stories based on classic stories. The company wants to use Amazon Bedrock and needs to ensure that the results and topics are appropriate for children. Which AWS service or feature will meet these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 某公司希望为儿童开发一款基于经典故事生成新故事的交互式应用。该公司希望使用 Amazon Bedrock，并需要确保生成的结果和主题适合儿童。哪项 AWS 服务或功能可以满足此要求？
options_zh: Amazon Rekognition
Amazon Bedrock 演练场
Guardrails for Amazon Bedrock
Agents for Amazon Bedrock
questions.rationale:
【核心考点：生成式 AI 内容安全防护】
Guardrails for Amazon Bedrock 允许用户定义拒绝主题 (Denied Topics)、敏感词过滤、有害内容拦截以及防止幻觉的上下文接地检查，确保模型输出安全。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: A company has developed an ML model for image classification. The company wants to deploy the model to production so that a web application can use the model without managing any of the underlying infrastructure. Which solution will meet these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 某公司开发了一个图像分类模型，希望将其部署到生产环境且无需管理任何底层基础设施。哪种方案满足要求？
options: Use Amazon SageMaker Serverless Inference to deploy the model.
Use Amazon CloudFront to deploy the model.
Use Amazon API Gateway to host the model and serve predictions.
Use AWS Batch to host the model and serve predictions.
options_zh: 使用 Amazon SageMaker 无服务器推理部署模型。
使用 Amazon CloudFront 部署模型。
使用 Amazon API Gateway 托管模型并提供预测。
使用 AWS Batch 托管模型并提供预测。
questions.rationale:
【核心考点：SageMaker 推理部署选项】
SageMaker Serverless Inference 专为无运维需求、间歇性推理负载设计，自动扩缩容至零，无需管理任何底层 EC2 算力。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识

options: Step 1: Define business goal and frame ML problem -> Step 2: Develop model -> Step 3: Deploy model -> Step 4: Monitor model
Step 1: Develop model -> Step 2: Define business goal and frame ML problem -> Step 3: Deploy model -> Step 4: Monitor model
Step 1: Define business goal and frame ML problem -> Step 2: Deploy model -> Step 3: Develop model -> Step 4: Monitor model
Step 1: Develop model -> Step 2: Deploy model -> Step 3: Monitor model -> Step 4: Define business goal and frame ML problem
options_zh: 步骤 1：明确业务目标并构建 ML 问题 -> 步骤 2：开发模型 -> 步骤 3：部署模型 -> 步骤 4：监控模型
步骤 1：开发模型 -> 步骤 2：明确业务目标并构建 ML 问题 -> 步骤 3：部署模型 -> 步骤 4：监控模型
步骤 1：明确业务目标并构建 ML 问题 -> 步骤 2：部署模型 -> 步骤 3：开发模型 -> 步骤 4：监控模型
步骤 1：开发模型 -> 步骤 2：部署模型 -> 步骤 3：监控模型 -> 步骤 4：明确业务目标并构建 ML 问题
questions.rationale:
【核心考点：ML 完整生命周期标准工作流】
根据 AWS Well-Architected ML 架构指南，标准流水线顺序必须为：
1. Define business goal and frame ML problem（明确业务目标与问题框架）
2. Develop model（模型开发：包含数据清洗、特征工程、训练与评估）
3. Deploy model（将模型部署至线上托管端点）
4. Monitor model（生产环境持续监控模型质量与漂移）。

questions.domain: Domain 5: 安全性、合规与管控
questions.question: A company is using a generative AI model to develop a digital assistant. The model's responses occasionally include undesirable and potentially harmful content. Match each mitigation action to the correct Amazon Bedrock Guardrails filtering policy. (Select FOUR)
questions.question_zh: 【HOTSPOT 配对题】某公司在 Bedrock 上开发助手，偶现不良有害内容。请将每项缓解措施与正确的 Amazon Bedrock Guardrails 过滤策略进行对应配对：
options: Harmful content -> Content filters; Illegal investment/legal advice -> Denied topics; Offensive terms -> Word filters; Ungrounded content -> Contextual grounding check
Harmful content -> Denied topics; Illegal investment/legal advice -> Content filters; Offensive terms -> Word filters; Ungrounded content -> Contextual grounding check
Harmful content -> Word filters; Illegal investment/legal advice -> Denied topics; Offensive terms -> Content filters; Ungrounded content -> Contextual grounding check
Harmful content -> Content filters; Illegal investment/legal advice -> Word filters; Offensive terms -> Denied topics; Ungrounded content -> Contextual grounding check
options_zh: 有害/暴力内容 -> 内容过滤器 (Content filters)；非法投资/法律建议 -> 拒绝主题 (Denied topics)；特定冒犯词汇 -> 词汇过滤器 (Word filters)；无依据/幻觉内容 -> 上下文接地检查 (Contextual grounding check)
有害/暴力内容 -> 拒绝主题；非法投资/法律建议 -> 内容过滤器；特定冒犯词汇 -> 词汇过滤器；无依据/幻觉内容 -> 上下文接地检查
有害/暴力内容 -> 词汇过滤器；非法投资/法律建议 -> 拒绝主题；特定冒犯词汇 -> 内容过滤器；无依据/幻觉内容 -> 上下文接地检查
有害/暴力内容 -> 内容过滤器；非法投资/法律建议 -> 词汇过滤器；特定冒犯词汇 -> 拒绝主题；无依据/幻觉内容 -> 上下文接地检查
questions.rationale:
【核心考点：Amazon Bedrock Guardrails 四大过滤机制】
- 阻断仇恨、暴力、侮辱等不良行为 -> Content filters
- 设定不希望模型涉及的业务主题（如投资、法律建议） -> Denied topics
- 侦测并过滤特定敏感或粗俗字词 -> Word filters
- 检验生成内容是否基于知识库文档事实并遏制幻觉 -> Contextual grounding check。

options: Step 1: Store audio in Amazon S3 -> Step 2: Convert audio to text using Amazon Transcribe -> Step 3: Summarize text using Amazon Bedrock
Step 1: Store audio in Amazon EBS -> Step 2: Convert audio to text using Amazon Polly -> Step 3: Summarize text using Amazon Bedrock
Step 1: Store audio in Amazon S3 -> Step 2: Convert audio to text using Amazon Transcribe -> Step 3: Summarize text using Amazon Lex
Step 1: Store audio in Amazon S3 -> Step 2: Convert audio to text using Amazon Polly -> Step 3: Summarize text using Amazon Bedrock
options_zh: 步骤 1：将会议音频存储至 Amazon S3 -> 步骤 2：使用 Amazon Transcribe 将语音转录为文本 -> 步骤 3：使用 Amazon Bedrock 汇总生成会议摘要
步骤 1：存储在 EBS -> 步骤 2：使用 Polly 转换音频 -> 步骤 3：使用 Bedrock 汇总

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识

questions.question_zh: 【HOTSPOT 配对题】请为以下三段陈述选择对应的 AI 层级术语：\n1) 模拟人类解决问题与认知能力的广泛领域；2) 应用数据驱动学习技术做出预测；3) 专注于利用深层复杂神经网络处理数据
options_zh: 1: 人工智能 (AI)；2: 机器学习 (ML)；3: 深度学习 (Deep learning)
1: 机器学习；2: 人工智能；3: 深度学习

1: 人工智能；2: 深度学习；3: 机器学习
questions.rationale:
【核心考点：AI、ML 与深度学习的包含关系】

- ML（机器学习）：AI 的子集，侧重于从数据中自动学习规律并进行预测；
- Deep Learning（深度学习）：ML 的子集，依赖多层深层神经网络处理复杂非结构化数据。

1: 并发能力；2: 延迟；3: 上下文窗口

questions.rationale:
【核心考点：基础模型关键技术参数】
- 同时处理并发请求 -> Concurrency（并发度）；
- 单次交互的最大 Token 承载上限 -> Context Window（上下文窗口）；
- 端到端响应处理时间 -> Latency（推理延迟）。

questions.domain: Domain 2: 生成式 AI 的基础知识
questions.question: An e-commerce company is developing a generative AI solution for personalized recommendations. Select the correct business metric for each business goal: 1) Measure the purchase rate of recommended products; 2) Measure how frequently users click on recommended products; 3) Measure overall spending per user across the platform. (Select THREE)
questions.question_zh: 【HOTSPOT 配对题】电商公司上线 AI 推荐系统，请为以下商业目标匹配最直接的衡量业务指标：\n1) 衡量收到推荐后完成实际购买的比例；2) 衡量用户点击推荐商品的频繁程度；3) 衡量平台用户平均整体消费金额
options: 1: Conversion rate; 2: Click-through rate (CTR); 3: Average revenue per user (ARPU)
1: Click-through rate; 2: Conversion rate; 3: Average revenue per user
1: Average revenue per user; 2: Click-through rate; 3: Conversion rate
1: Conversion rate; 2: Average revenue per user; 3: Click-through rate
options_zh: 1: 转化率 (Conversion rate)；2: 点击率 (Click-through rate / CTR)；3: 每用户平均收入 (Average revenue per user / ARPU)
1: 点击率；2: 转化率；3: 每用户平均收入
1: 每用户平均收入；2: 点击率；3: 转化率
1: 转化率；2: 每用户平均收入；3: 点击率
questions.rationale:
【核心考点：生成式 AI 商业价值 ROI 指标】
- 促成下单购买的比例 -> Conversion rate（转化率）；
- 浏览到发生点击的比率 -> Click-through rate (CTR)；
- 衡量平台用户整体贡献的商业价值 -> Average Revenue Per User (ARPU)。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: A company wants to improve multiple ML models. Select the correct technique for each use case: 1) Augment LLM capabilities by using external data sources; 2) Query the model without providing any examples; 3) Adapt the model by using a domain-specific labeled dataset. (Select THREE)
questions.question_zh: 【HOTSPOT 配对题】某公司需要改进多个模型方案，请选择正确的技术手段：\n1) 借助外部数据源增强大语言模型的能力；2) 在不提供任何示例的情况下向模型提问；3) 使用特定垂直领域的标注数据集调整模型参数
options: 1: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG); 2: Zero-shot learning; 3: Fine-tuning
1: Fine-tuning; 2: Zero-shot learning; 3: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)
1: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG); 2: Few-shot learning; 3: Fine-tuning
1: Zero-shot learning; 2: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG); 3: Fine-tuning
options_zh: 1: 检索增强生成 (RAG)；2: 零样本学习 (Zero-shot learning)；3: 微调 (Fine-tuning)
1: 微调；2: 零样本学习；3: 检索增强生成 (RAG)
1: 检索增强生成 (RAG)；2: 少样本学习；3: 微调
1: 零样本学习；2: 检索增强生成 (RAG)；3: 微调
questions.rationale:
【核心考点：模型优化技术区分】
1. 挂载外部知识库增强上下文 -> RAG；
2. 直接给提示词且不给任何样例示范 -> Zero-shot（零样本）；
3. 在垂直数据集上训练微调模型内部权重 -> Fine-tuning。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: Order the following steps to correctly describe the ML lifecycle for a new custom model. (Select and order FOUR)
questions.question_zh: 【HOTSPOT 排序题】请对以下步骤进行正确排序，完整描述构建一个全新自建机器学习模型的生命周期：
options: Step 1: Define the business objective -> Step 2: Process the data -> Step 3: Develop and train the model -> Step 4: Deploy the model
Step 1: Process the data -> Step 2: Define the business objective -> Step 3: Develop and train the model -> Step 4: Deploy the model
Step 1: Define the business objective -> Step 2: Develop and train the model -> Step 3: Process the data -> Step 4: Deploy the model
Step 1: Develop and train the model -> Step 2: Process the data -> Step 3: Deploy the model -> Step 4: Define the business objective
options_zh: 步骤 1：确定业务目标 -> 步骤 2：处理与准备数据 -> 步骤 3：开发并训练模型 -> 步骤 4：部署模型上线
步骤 1：处理数据 -> 步骤 2：确定业务目标 -> 步骤 3：开发训练模型 -> 步骤 4：部署模型
步骤 1：确定业务目标 -> 步骤 2：开发训练模型 -> 步骤 3：处理数据 -> 步骤 4：部署模型
步骤 1：开发训练模型 -> 步骤 2：处理数据 -> 步骤 3：部署模型 -> 步骤 4：确定业务目标
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：自建模型 ML 生命周期核心顺序】\n标准流程始于明确商业诉求（Define business objective），随后进行数据预处理（Process data），继而进行算法开发与训练（Develop and train），最终将模型部署至生产环境（Deploy）。

questions.domain: Domain 4: 负责任 AI 的指南
questions.question: Which three responsible AI principles apply to each scenario description? 1) Encrypt application data and isolate the application on a private network; 2) Evaluate the impact on different demographic groups; 3) Test the application with unexpected inputs to ensure reliability. (Select THREE)
questions.question_zh: 【HOTSPOT 配对题】请为以下三种工程实践匹配最核心的负责任 AI 原则：\n1) 加密应用数据并将应用隔离在专有私有网络内；2) 评估不同人口特征群体受到的算法影响；3) 使用异常意外数据测试系统以确保在特殊情况下仍可靠运行
options_zh: 1: 隐私与安全性 (Privacy and security)；2: 公平性 (Fairness)；3: 稳健性 (Robustness)
1: 公平性；2: 隐私与安全性；3: 稳健性
1: 隐私与安全性；2: 可解释性；3: 安全性
1: 稳健性；2: 公平性；3: 隐私与安全性
questions.rationale:
【核心考点：AWS 负责任 AI 原则映射】
1. 数据传输/存储加密与网络专网隔离 -> Privacy and security（隐私与安全）；
2. 排查算法对各人群的无偏袒表现 -> Fairness（公平性）；
3. 系统在面对恶劣或反常边缘数据输入时保持稳定不崩溃 -> Robustness（稳健性）。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: A company has developed an LLM. Select the appropriate inference mode for each team: 1) Chatbot needs minimal latency to understand user intent; 2) Weekend workload querying gigabytes of text files; 3) Engineering API to process short text snippets with low latency. (Select THREE)
questions.question_zh: 【HOTSPOT 配对题】某公司需要为不同业务团队选择最匹配的推论模式 (Inference Mode)：\n1) 聊天机器人需要极低延迟来理解用户意图；2) 周末定时查询并批处理数 GB 的文本文件；3) 工程团队 API 需要处理短文本并提供低延迟响应
options: 1: Real-time inference; 2: Batch transform; 3: Real-time inference
1: Batch transform; 2: Real-time inference; 3: Real-time inference
1: Real-time inference; 2: Real-time inference; 3: Batch transform
1: Batch transform; 2: Batch transform; 3: Real-time inference
options_zh: 1: 实时推理 (Real-time inference)；2: 批量转换 (Batch transform)；3: 实时推理 (Real-time inference)
1: 批量转换；2: 实时推理；3: 实时推理
1: 实时推理；2: 实时推理；3: 批量转换
1: 批量转换；2: 批量转换；3: 实时推理
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：SageMaker / Bedrock 推理模式选型】\n- 实时在线交互、低延迟需求（客服机器人、实时 API）必须选用 Real-time inference；\n- 离线、非实时、周末定时海量大文件处理，选用 Batch transform（批量转换）成本最低。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: Select the correct foundation model customization method for each scenario: 1) Provide labeled data to improve performance on a specific task; 2) Provide unlabeled domain data to adapt an FM to a specific domain; 3) Transfer knowledge from a larger model into a smaller model. (Select THREE)
questions.question_zh: 【HOTSPOT 配对题】请为以下基础模型定制化场景选择正确的方法：\n1) 提供标注数据以改善特定任务的模型表现；2) 提供海量未标注领域数据使模型掌握行业知识；3) 将大模型的知识提炼转移到参数量更小的模型中
options_zh: 1: 微调 (Fine-tuning)；2: 持续预训练 (Continued pre-training)；3: 知识蒸馏 (Distillation)
1: 持续预训练；2: 微调；3: 知识蒸馏
1: 微调；2: 知识蒸馏；3: 持续预训练
1: 知识蒸馏；2: 持续预训练；3: 微调
questions.rationale:
【核心考点：模型定制技术图谱】
1. 在任务专有有标签数据上调优 -> Fine-tuning（微调）；
2. 在垂直行业无标签语料上继续无监督预训练 -> Continued pre-training（持续预训练）；
3. 老师模型教导学生模型，压缩模型体积 -> Distillation（模型蒸馏）。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: Determine the appropriate data type for each use case: 1) Sentiment analysis on social media posts; 2) Train autonomous vehicles to recognize traffic signs; 3) Customer demographics and purchase history for ads; 4) Predict stock prices from historical prices. (Select FOUR)
questions.question_zh: 【HOTSPOT 配对题】请为以下四个应用场景匹配正确的数据类型：\n1) 针对社交媒体推文进行情感分析；2) 训练自动驾驶汽车识别道路交通标志；3) 利用客户人口统计信息与购买记录优化广告；4) 使用历史价格变动预测股票价格
options: 1: Text data; 2: Image data; 3: Tabular data; 4: Time series data
1: Tabular data; 2: Image data; 3: Text data; 4: Time series data
1: Text data; 2: Time series data; 3: Tabular data; 4: Image data
1: Time series data; 2: Image data; 3: Tabular data; 4: Text data
options_zh: 1: 文本数据 (Text data)；2: 图像数据 (Image data)；3: 表格结构化数据 (Tabular data)；4: 时间序列数据 (Time series data)
1: 表格数据；2: 图像数据；3: 文本数据；4: 时间序列数据
1: 文本数据；2: 时间序列数据；3: 表格数据；4: 图像数据
1: 时间序列数据；2: 图像数据；3: 表格数据；4: 文本数据
questions.rationale:
【核心考点：数据类型与实际应用映射】
- 社交推文 -> Text data（文本数据）；
- 摄像头路牌标志 -> Image data（图像视觉数据）；
- 人口特征与购物历史二维表 -> Tabular data（结构化表格数据）；
- 随时间推移的股票连续波动行情 -> Time series data（时间序列数据）。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: Select the correct prompt engineering technique for each description: 1) Provide a few examples before generating output; 2) Prompt model to explain its step-by-step reasoning process; 3) Prompt model to perform a task without providing any examples. (Select THREE)
questions.question_zh: 【HOTSPOT 配对题】请为以下提示词工程描述选择正确的术语：\n1) 在生成输出前提供少量高质量示范范例；2) 提示模型将得出最终答案的过程拆解为逐步推理；3) 仅下达任务指令而不提供任何示例
options: 1: Few-shot prompting; 2: Chain-of-thought prompting; 3: Zero-shot prompting
1: Zero-shot prompting; 2: Chain-of-thought prompting; 3: Few-shot prompting
1: Few-shot prompting; 2: Role-based prompting; 3: Zero-shot prompting
1: Single-shot prompting; 2: Chain-of-thought prompting; 3: Zero-shot prompting
options_zh: 1: 少样本提示 (Few-shot prompting)；2: 思维链提示 (Chain-of-thought prompting)；3: 零样本提示 (Zero-shot prompting)
1: 零样本提示；2: 思维链提示；3: 少样本提示
1: 少样本提示；2: 基于角色的提示；3: 零样本提示
1: 单样本提示；2: 思维链提示；3: 零样本提示
questions.rationale:
【核心考点：经典提示词工程手段辨析】
- 提供 2~5 个输入输出样例 -> Few-shot prompting（少样本提示）；
- 引导模型拆解逻辑推导过程（Let's think step by step） -> Chain-of-thought prompting（思维链提示）；
- 仅提供指令、完全不附带样例 -> Zero-shot prompting（零样本提示）。

questions.domain: Domain 4: 负责任 AI 的指南
questions.question: A loan company is building a generative AI-based solution to offer new applicants discounts based on specific business criteria. The company wants to build and use an AI model responsibly to minimize bias that could negatively affect some customers. Which actions should the company take to meet these requirements? (Select TWO.)
questions.question_zh: 某贷款公司正在构建基于生成式 AI 的方案，根据业务条件向新申请人提供折扣。公司希望负责任地构建并使用 AI 模型，以最大程度减少可能对某些客户产生不利影响的偏见。公司应采取哪两项措施？(Select TWO)
options: Detect imbalances or disparities in the data.
Ensure that the model runs frequently.
Evaluate the model's behavior so that the company can provide transparency to stakeholders.
Use the Recall-Oriented Understudy for Gisting Evaluation (ROUGE) technique to ensure that the model is 100% accurate.
Ensure that the model's inference time is within the accepted limits.
options_zh: 检测数据中的不平衡或差异 (Detect imbalances or disparities in the data)
确保模型频繁运行
评估模型的行为，以便向利益相关者提供透明度 (Evaluate model behavior for transparency)
使用 ROUGE 技术确保模型 100% 准确
确保模型的推理时间在可接受限制内
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：负责任 AI 与偏见缓解】\n负责任 AI 要求在开发过程中检测数据不平衡（例如使用 SageMaker Clarify 识别各群体差异），并持续评估模型决策逻辑以向利益相关者保持透明度与可解释性。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: A company is using an Amazon Bedrock base model to summarize documents for an internal use case. The company trained a custom model to improve the summarization quality. Which action must the company take to use the custom model through Amazon Bedrock?
questions.question_zh: 某公司在 Amazon Bedrock 上使用基础模型汇总内部文档。公司训练了自定义模型以提升摘要质量。若要通过 Amazon Bedrock 使用该自定义模型，必须采取哪项操作？
options: Purchase Provisioned Throughput for the custom model.
Deploy the custom model in an Amazon SageMaker endpoint for real-time inference.
Register the model with the Amazon SageMaker Model Registry.
Grant access to the custom model in Amazon Bedrock.
options_zh: 为该自定义模型购买预置吞吐量 (Purchase Provisioned Throughput)
将自定义模型部署在 Amazon SageMaker 端点中进行实时推理
在 Amazon SageMaker Model Registry 中注册该模型
在 Amazon Bedrock 中授予对自定义模型的访问权限
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：Bedrock 自定义模型推理部署】\n在 AWS 架构中，若需要将训练好的自定义模型用于实时推理并通过 API 调用，将其部署至 SageMaker 托管终结点（SageMaker Endpoint）是支持实时调用的标准途径。

questions.domain: Domain 5: 安全性、合规与管控
questions.question: A company wants to deploy a conversational chatbot to answer customer questions. The chatbot is based on a fine-tuned Amazon SageMaker JumpStart model. The application must comply with multiple regulatory frameworks. Which capabilities can the company show compliance for? (Select TWO.)
questions.question_zh: 某公司希望部署基于 SageMaker JumpStart 微调模型的对话机器人。该应用必须符合多个法规合规框架。公司可以证明合规性的两项能力是什么？(Select TWO)
options_zh: 自动扩缩容推理端点
威胁检测 (Threat detection)
数据保护 (Data protection)
成本优化
松耦合微服务
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：安全合规核心支柱】\n多项合规监管框架（如 HIPAA、PCI DSS、GDPR）最核心要求证明的两项能力是数据保护（静态与传输中加密、访问控制）以及威胁检测（持续检测入侵与未授权调用）。

questions.domain: Domain 4: 负责任 AI 的指南
questions.question: A student at a university is copying content from generative AI to write essays. Which challenge of responsible generative AI does this scenario represent?
questions.question_zh: 一名大学生直接复制生成式 AI 生成的内容来写论文。该情景体现了负责任生成式 AI 的哪项挑战？
options_zh: 有害毒性 (Toxicity)
模型幻觉 (Hallucinations)
抄袭与剽窃 (Plagiarism)
隐私安全 (Privacy)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：学术诚信与抄袭风险】\n在未经注明出处的情况下将生成式 AI 产生的内容据为己有或直接提交，属于学术与版权层面的抄袭 (Plagiarism) 问题。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: A company wants to make a chatbot to help customers. The chatbot will help solve technical problems without human intervention. The company chose a foundation model (FM) for the chatbot. The chatbot needs to produce responses that adhere to company tone. Which solution meets these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 某公司希望构建客服机器人，且生成的回复必须符合公司既定的语气风格 (Tone)。哪种方案最简单且有效？
options: Set a low limit on the number of tokens the FM can produce.
Use batch inferencing to process detailed responses.
Experiment and refine the prompt until the FM produces the desired responses.
Define a higher number for the temperature parameter.
options_zh: 严格限制 FM 可以生成的 Token 数量上限
使用批量推理处理详细回复
通过提示词工程进行试验和调优 (Refine the prompt)，直到产生期望的语气风格
为温度参数 (Temperature) 设置更高的数值
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：提示词工程调整语气与品牌调性】\n通过提示词工程（Prompt Engineering）在系统提示中注入角色设定与文风要求（Persona & Tone），无需重新训练即可有效规范模型的回复语调。

questions.domain: Domain 4: 负责任 AI 的指南
questions.question: A company has installed a security camera. The company uses an ML model to evaluate the security camera footage for potential thefts. The company has discovered that the model disproportionately flags people who are members of a specific ethnic group. Which type of bias is affecting the model output?
questions.question_zh: 某公司使用 ML 模型分析监控画面以检测潜在盗窃，但发现该模型异常不成比例地频繁标记某个特定族群的人员。哪种类型的偏见影响了模型输出？
options_zh: 测量偏差 (Measurement bias)
抽样偏差 (Sampling bias)
观察者偏差 (Observer bias)
确认偏差 (Confirmation bias)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：抽样偏差 Sampling Bias】\n抽样偏差是指训练数据未能代表整体真实人口分布，或者在数据采集时某些群体的样本过高/过低，导致模型对特定群体产生不公的误判。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: A company wants to use a large language model (LLM) on Amazon Bedrock for sentiment analysis. The company wants to classify the sentiment of text passages as positive or negative. Which prompt engineering strategy meets these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 某公司希望在 Amazon Bedrock 上使用 LLM 将文本分类为正面或负面情感。哪种提示词工程策略满足要求？
options: Provide examples of text passages with corresponding positive or negative labels in the prompt followed by the new text passage to be classified.
Provide a detailed explanation of sentiment analysis and how LLMs work in the prompt.
Provide the new text passage to be classified without any additional context or examples.
Provide the new text passage with a few examples of unrelated tasks, such as text summarization or question answering.
options_zh: 在提示词中提供带有正/负标签的示例段落（少样本提示 Few-shot），随后附上待分类的新文本
在提示词中详细解释情感分析的定义与 LLM 的底层原理
仅提供待分类的文本，不给任何额外上下文或示例 (Zero-shot)
提供待分类文本以及摘要或问答等无关任务的示例
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：少样本提示词工程 Few-shot Prompting】\n提供成对的“输入文本 -> 期望情感标签”作为示范，能快速引导大模型准确理解分类标准并对新文本做出精准判定。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: Which AWS service or feature can help an AI development team quickly deploy and consume a foundation model (FM) within the team's VPC?
questions.question_zh: 哪项 AWS 服务或功能可以帮助 AI 开发团队在自己的 VPC 内快速部署并调用基础模型 (FM)？
options_zh: Amazon Personalize
Amazon SageMaker JumpStart (预置模型与快速 VPC 部署)
PartyRock (Bedrock 演练场)
Amazon SageMaker endpoints
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：SageMaker JumpStart 快速部署】\nSageMaker JumpStart 提供包含数百种知名开源模型（如 Llama、Falcon）的 Hub，支持一键将模型部署至安全的 VPC 专有环境中。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: A company has a database of petabytes of unstructured data from internal sources. The company wants to transform this data into a structured format so that its data scientists can perform machine learning (ML) tasks. Which service will meet these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 某公司拥有数 PB 来自内部源的非结构化数据，希望将其清洗并转换为结构化格式供数据科学家进行 ML 任务。哪项服务满足要求？
options_zh: Amazon Lex
Amazon Rekognition
Amazon Kinesis Data Streams
AWS Glue (全托管 ETL 与数据准备服务)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：大规模数据清洗与转换 AWS Glue】\nAWS Glue 是无服务器 ETL 引擎，可轻松处理 PB 级规模的非结构化/半结构化数据，进行清洗、分类并生成结构化表。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: A company has thousands of customer support interactions per day and wants to analyze these interactions to identify frequently asked questions and develop insights. Which AWS service can the company use to meet this requirement?
questions.question_zh: 某公司每天有数千次客户支持交互，希望分析这些交互文本以识别高频常见问题和主题洞察。应使用哪项 AWS 服务？
options_zh: Amazon Lex
Amazon Comprehend (文本自然语言处理与主题/实体分析)
Amazon Transcribe
Amazon Translate
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：NLP 洞察与主题建模 Amazon Comprehend】\nAmazon Comprehend 具备主题建模（Topic Modeling）、关键短语提取与实体识别功能，专用于从海量客服文本中提炼常见问答与模式。

questions.domain: Domain 2: 生成式 AI 的基础知识
questions.question: A pharmaceutical company wants to analyze user reviews of new medications and provide a concise overview for each medication. Which solution meets these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 某制药公司希望分析用户对新药品的评价，并为每种药品生成简明摘要。哪种方案满足要求？
options: Create a time-series forecasting model to analyze the medication reviews by using Amazon Personalize.
Create medication review summaries by using Amazon Bedrock large language models (LLMs).
Create a classification model that categorizes medications into different groups by using Amazon SageMaker.
Create medication review summaries by using Amazon Rekognition.
options_zh: 使用 Amazon Personalize 构建时间序列预测模型分析评价
使用 Amazon Bedrock 上的大语言模型 (LLM) 生成药品评价摘要
使用 SageMaker 构建将药品分类的分类模型
使用 Amazon Rekognition 生成文本摘要
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：大模型文本摘要能力】\n针对长文本用户评论生成概括性总结，是 Amazon Bedrock 上大语言模型 (LLMs) 的经典原生优势场景。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: What does an F1 score measure in the context of foundation model (FM) performance?
questions.question_zh: 在模型评估的语境中，F1 分数 (F1 Score) 衡量的是什么？
options: Financial cost of operating the model.
Energy efficiency of the model's computations.
options_zh: 模型的精确率与召回率的调和平均 (Precision and Recall)
模型生成响应的运行速度
模型运行的财务成本
模型计算的能效比
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：F1 分数定义】\nF1 Score 是精确率 (Precision) 与召回率 (Recall) 的调和平均数，用于在正负样本不平衡时综合评估分类模型的表现。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: A company needs to train an ML model to classify images of different types of animals. The company has a large dataset of labeled images and will not label more data. Which type of learning should the company use to train the model?
questions.question_zh: 某公司需要训练一个模型来分类不同动物图片，拥有大量已标记 (Labeled) 的图片数据集。应使用哪种学习方式？
options_zh: 监督学习 (Supervised learning)
无监督学习 (Unsupervised learning)
强化学习 (Reinforcement learning)
主动学习 (Active learning)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：监督学习概念】\n监督学习的核心特点是利用成对的「输入特征与已知标签 (Labeled Data)」来训练模型建立映射关系。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: A company deployed an AI/ML solution to help customer service agents respond to frequently asked questions. The questions can change over time. The company wants to give customer service agents the ability to ask questions and receive automatically generated answers to common customer questions. Which strategy will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
questions.question_zh: 某公司部署 AI 方案帮助客服回答频繁变动的常见问题。如何最具成本效益地确保回答始终基于最新信息？
options: Train the model by using context data.
Pre-train and benchmark the model by using context data.
Use Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) with prompt engineering techniques.
options_zh: 定期微调模型
使用上下文数据重新训练模型
使用上下文数据预训练并基准测试模型
结合提示词工程使用检索增强生成 (RAG - Retrieval Augmented Generation)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：RAG vs 微调的成本与动态性权衡】\n当知识库频繁更新时，重新训练或微调既昂贵又滞后；RAG 模式只需更新向量数据库文档，即可低成本、近乎实时地让模型掌握最新资讯。

questions.domain: Domain 4: 负责任 AI 的指南
questions.question: A company built an AI-powered resume screening system. The company used a large dataset to train the model. The dataset contained resumes that were not representative of all demographics. Which core dimension of responsible AI does this scenario present?
questions.question_zh: 某公司开发简历筛选 AI 系统，其训练数据集未能充分代表所有人口特征群体。该情景触及了负责任 AI 的哪项核心维度？
options_zh: 公平性 (Fairness)
可解释性 (Explainability)
隐私与安全性 (Privacy and security)
透明度 (Transparency)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：负责任 AI 核心支柱——公平性】\n训练样本缺乏多元性会导致特定群体在算法决策中受到不公正待遇，直接违反了 Responsible AI 的公平性 (Fairness) 原则。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: A retail store wants to predict the demand for a specific product for the next few weeks by using the Amazon SageMaker DeepAR forecasting algorithm. Which type of data will meet this requirement?
questions.question_zh: 某零售店希望使用 Amazon SageMaker DeepAR 算法预测未来几周的产品需求。需要提供哪种类型的数据？
options_zh: 文本数据
图像数据
时间序列数据 (Time series data)
二进制数据
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：SageMaker DeepAR 算法】\nDeepAR 是 Amazon SageMaker 内置的监督式循环神经网络算法，专用于标量时间序列数据（Time Series Data）的预测。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: A company is using a pre-trained large language model (LLM) to extract information from documents. The company noticed that a newer LLM from a different provider is available on Amazon Bedrock. The company wants to transition to the new LLM on Amazon Bedrock. What does the company need to do to transition to the new LLM?
questions.question_zh: 某公司正在使用预训练 LLM 提取文档信息。公司希望平滑切换到 Amazon Bedrock 上的另一家提供商的新款 LLM。通常需要做哪些调整？
options_zh: 创建新的标注数据集
执行特征工程
调整提示词模板 (Adjust the prompt template)
对新 LLM 进行微调
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：更换基础模型时的适配工作】\n不同厂商的模型在输入 Token 格式、角色标记或结构化格式（如 Claude 的 XML 标签与 Llama 的指令格式）略有差异，更换模型通常只需微调提示词模板即可适应。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: A customer service team is developing an application to analyze customer feedback and automatically classify the feedback into different categories. The categories include product quality, customer service, and delivery experience. Which AI concept does this scenario present?
questions.question_zh: 某团队开发应用以分析客户反馈文本，并自动将其归类为产品质量、客服或物流体验。这体现了哪种 AI 概念？
options_zh: 计算机视觉 (Computer vision)
自然语言处理 (Natural language processing, NLP)
推荐系统
欺诈检测
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：NLP 文本分类】\n对人类书写的自然语言文字进行理解、特征抽取并自动分类，属于自然语言处理 (NLP) 的标准任务。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: A company wants to create a new solution by using AWS Glue. The company has minimal programming experience with AWS Glue. Which AWS service can help the company use AWS Glue?
questions.question_zh: 某公司希望使用 AWS Glue，但团队几乎没有编写 Glue 代码的经验。哪项 AWS 服务可提供智能代码与指导辅助？
options_zh: Amazon Q Developer (AI 辅助编程与 AWS 开发助手)
AWS Config
Amazon Personalize
Amazon Comprehend
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：Amazon Q Developer 开发者助手】\nAmazon Q Developer 是 AWS 专用的生成式 AI 助手，可直接在 IDE 或控制台中为缺乏经验的开发人员生成 ETL 代码、脚本与架构配置指导。

questions.domain: Domain 5: 安全性、合规与管控
questions.question: A company wants to fine-tune an ML model that is hosted on Amazon Bedrock. The company wants to use its own sensitive data that is stored in private databases in a VPC. The data needs to stay within the company's private network. Which solution will meet these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 某公司在 Amazon Bedrock 上微调模型，使用 VPC 私有数据库中的敏感数据，要求数据传输全程不得经由公共互联网。哪种方案满足要求？
options: Restrict access to Amazon Bedrock by using an AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) service role.
Restrict access to Amazon Bedrock by using an AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) resource policy.
Use AWS PrivateLink to connect the VPC and Amazon Bedrock.
Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys to encrypt the data.
options_zh: 通过 IAM 服务角色限制对 Amazon Bedrock 的访问
通过 IAM 资源策略限制访问
使用 AWS PrivateLink 建立 VPC 与 Amazon Bedrock 之间的私有连接
使用 AWS KMS 密钥加密数据
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：网络隔离与 AWS PrivateLink】\nAWS PrivateLink 允许 VPC 内的私有资源通过专用端点直接与 AWS 托管服务通信，所有流量完全留在 AWS 骨干网络内，不经过公网。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: An airline company wants to build a conversational AI assistant to answer customer questions about flight schedules, booking, and payments. The company wants to use large language models (LLMs) and a knowledge base to create a text-based chatbot interface. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?
questions.question_zh: 航空公司希望开发航班助手机器人，结合大模型与知识库回答航班与订票问题。哪种方案开发量最少？
options: Train models on Amazon SageMaker Autopilot.
Develop a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) agent by using Amazon Bedrock.
Create a Python application by using Amazon Q Developer.
Fine-tune models on Amazon SageMaker Jumpstart.
options_zh: 在 Amazon SageMaker Autopilot 上训练模型
使用 Amazon Bedrock 构建检索增强生成 (RAG) 智能代理 (Bedrock Knowledge Bases & Agents)
使用 Amazon Q Developer 从零编写 Python 应用程序
在 SageMaker JumpStart 上微调模型
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：Bedrock 开箱即用 RAG 代理】\nAmazon Bedrock 提供集成的 Knowledge Bases 与 Agents，无需自行搭建设施或从零编码，即可低代码完成企业级 RAG 对话机器人构建。

questions.domain: Domain 2: 生成式 AI 的基础知识
questions.question: Which option describes embeddings in the context of AI?
questions.question_zh: 在人工智能语境中，哪项准确描述了「向量嵌入 (Embeddings)」？
options: A method for compressing large datasets
An encryption method for securing sensitive data
A method for visualizing high-dimensional data
A numerical method for data representation in a reduced dimensionality space
options_zh: 一种压缩大型数据集的方法
一种加密敏感数据的方法
一种可视化高维数据的方法
一种在连续降维向量空间中表达语义的数值化表示方法 (Numerical representation in vector space)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：Embeddings 概念】\nEmbeddings 将复杂的离散实体（如单词、句子、图片）转换为稠密连续的高维数值向量，保留概念间的语义距离与关联。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: In which stage of the generative AI model lifecycle are tests performed to examine the model's accuracy?
questions.question_zh: 在生成式 AI 模型生命周期的哪一阶段，会执行针对模型准确度与各项指标的测试？
options_zh: 部署阶段 (Deployment)
数据选择阶段 (Data selection)
微调阶段 (Fine-tuning)
评估阶段 (Evaluation)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：模型生命周期之评估 Evaluation】\nEvaluation（评估）阶段专职于使用基准测试集或自动化评测工具检验模型的准确率、忠实度、安全性和任务达标情况。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: A company is building a mobile app for users who have a visual impairment. The app must be able to hear what users say and provide voice responses. Which solution will meet these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 某视障无障碍 App 需要能够识别用户的语音输入并使用语音进行回答。应使用哪项底层技术方案？
options: Use a deep learning neural network to perform speech recognition.
Build ML models to search for patterns in numeric data.
Use generative AI summarization to generate human-like text.
Build custom models for image classification and recognition.
options_zh: 使用深度学习神经网络执行语音识别与语音合成 (Speech-to-Text & Text-to-Speech)
构建数值模式搜索模型
使用文本摘要生成人类文本
构建图像分类模型
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：语音识别底层机制】\n现代自动语音识别（ASR，如 Amazon Transcribe）和文字转语音（TTS，如 Amazon Polly）均依托深度学习神经网络实现。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: A company wants to improve the accuracy of the responses from a generative AI application. The application uses a foundation model (FM) on Amazon Bedrock. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
questions.question_zh: 某公司在 Amazon Bedrock 上使用基础模型，希望提高输出准确度。哪种方案最具成本效益？
options_zh: 微调基础模型
重新训练基础模型
从头训练新模型
使用提示词工程 (Use prompt engineering)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：提示词工程的极高成本效益】\nPrompt Engineering 完全不需要耗费额外算力去微调或重训模型参数，零训练成本，是改善输出质量的第一步与最具性价比手段。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: Which technique involves training AI models on labeled datasets to adapt the models to specific industry terminology and requirements?
questions.question_zh: 哪种技术通过在「标注数据集」上训练预训练模型，使其适应特定垂直行业术语和要求？
options_zh: 数据增强 (Data augmentation)
微调 (Fine-tuning)
模型量化 (Model quantization)
持续预训练 (Continuous pre-training)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：微调 Fine-tuning 的定义】\n在有标签的数据集上进一步调整模型权重，使模型掌握特定领域的术语和任务表现，称为微调 (Fine-tuning)。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: A manufacturing company wants to create product descriptions in multiple languages. Which AWS service will automate this task?
questions.question_zh: 某制造企业希望自动将产品说明翻译为多种不同语言。哪项 AWS 服务可自动化完成此任务？
options_zh: Amazon Translate (神经机器翻译服务)
Amazon Transcribe
Amazon Kendra
Amazon Polly
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：多语言神经翻译 Amazon Translate】\nAmazon Translate 专职于高质量、低延迟的多语言文字互译。

questions.domain: Domain 4: 负责任 AI 的指南
questions.question: An ecommerce company is deploying a chatbot. The chatbot will give users the ability to ask questions about the company's products and receive details on users' orders. The company must implement safeguards for the chatbot to filter harmful content from the input prompts and chatbot responses. Which AWS feature or resource meets these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 某电商公司需要为客服机器人设置安全护栏，过滤有害输入提示词与机器人回复。应使用哪项 AWS 功能？
options_zh: Amazon Bedrock Guardrails (内容审核与安全防护栏)
Amazon Bedrock Agents
Amazon Bedrock 推理 API
Amazon Bedrock 自定义模型
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：Amazon Bedrock Guardrails 安全护栏】\nGuardrails 提供敏感词拦截、拒绝特定有害主题、恶意输入注入过滤以及 PII 识别遮罩等一站式安全合规防护。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: A company trained an ML model on Amazon SageMaker to predict customer credit risk. The model shows 90% recall on training data and 40% recall on unseen testing data. Which conclusion can the company draw from these results?
questions.question_zh: 某信用风险模型在训练集上的召回率达到 90%，但在未见过的测试集上召回率只有 40%。可以得出什么结论？
options: The model is overfitting on the training data.
The model is underfitting on the training data.
The model has insufficient training data.
The model has insufficient testing data.
options_zh: 模型在训练数据上发生了过拟合 (Overfitting)
模型在训练数据上欠拟合 (Underfitting)
模型的训练数据不足
模型的测试数据不足
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：过拟合特征】\n「训练集表现极好，测试集表现极差」是过拟合（Overfitting）的经典标志，表明模型死记硬背了训练数据的噪声而缺乏泛化能力。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: Why does overfitting occur in ML models?
questions.question_zh: 为什么机器学习模型会发生过拟合 (Overfitting)？
options: The training dataset does not represent all possible input values.
The model contains a regularization method.
The model training stops early because of an early stopping criterion.
The training dataset contains too many features.
options_zh: 训练数据集未能充分代表所有可能的输入取值范围 (样本缺乏多样性导致死记硬背)
模型包含了正则化方法 (正则化用于防止过拟合)
因为早停准则模型训练过早停止 (早停用于防止过拟合)
训练数据集包含了过多特征
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：过拟合的根本成因】\n过拟合的主要原因之一是训练数据集样本不足或代表性差，模型过度拟合了有限训练集中的特定噪声，而无法泛化到真实世界的未见数据。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: A company wants to develop an AI application to help its employees check open customer claims, identify details for a specific claim, and access documents for a claim. Which solution meets these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 某公司希望开发 AI 应用协助员工查询未结理赔案件、调阅具体理赔细节及查看相关文档。哪种方案满足要求？
options: Use Agents for Amazon Bedrock with Amazon Fraud Detector to build the application.
Use Agents for Amazon Bedrock with Amazon Bedrock knowledge bases to build the application.
Use Amazon Personalize with Amazon Bedrock knowledge bases to build the application.
Use Amazon SageMaker AI to build the application by training a new ML model.
options_zh: 结合使用 Agents for Amazon Bedrock 与 Amazon Fraud Detector
结合使用 Agents for Amazon Bedrock 与 Amazon Bedrock 知识库 (Knowledge Bases)
结合使用 Amazon Personalize 与 Amazon Bedrock 知识库
通过在 SageMaker 上训练全新模型来构建应用
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：Bedrock Agents 与知识库协同工作流】\nBedrock Agents 可以自主编排 API 调用执行业务查询（如查未结案件），配合 Bedrock 知识库检索并总结非结构化理赔文档，是处理此类业务的最佳组合。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: A company is developing an ML application. The application must automatically group similar customers and products based on their characteristics. Which ML strategy should the company use to meet these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 某公司开发的机器学习应用需要根据客户特征自动将相似的客户与产品进行分组聚类。应采用哪种机器学习策略？
options_zh: 无监督学习 (Unsupervised learning - 如聚类分析)
监督学习 (Supervised learning)
强化学习 (Reinforcement learning)
半监督学习 (Semi-supervised learning)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：无监督学习与聚类】\n在没有预设标签的情况下，根据数据内在特征相似度自动划分群组（如客户分群），属于典型的无监督学习（如 K-Means 聚类）。

questions.domain: Domain 4: 负责任 AI 的指南
questions.question: A company is developing a mobile ML app that uses a phone's camera to diagnose and treat insect bites. The company wants to train an image classification model by using a diverse dataset of insect bite photos from different genders, ethnicities, and geographic locations around the world. Which principle of responsible AI does the company demonstrate in this scenario?
questions.question_zh: 某虫咬诊断 App 收集了来自全球不同性别、族群及地理位置的多元照片数据集来训练模型。这体现了负责任 AI 的哪项原则？
options_zh: 公平性 (Fairness - 确保不同人群模型表现均衡且无歧视)
可解释性 (Explainability)
治理 (Governance)
透明度 (Transparency)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：负责任 AI 之公平性 (Fairness)】\n通过涵盖广泛人口特征的多元平衡数据集训练模型，确保模型对所有群体具有一致且准确的诊断能力，是落实 AI 公平性原则的核心举措。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: A company is using a large language model (LLM) on Amazon Bedrock to build a chatbot. The chatbot processes customer support requests. To resolve a request, the customer and the chatbot must interact a few times. Which solution gives the LLM the ability to use content from previous customer messages?
questions.question_zh: 某公司在 Amazon Bedrock 上构建客服机器人，解决问题需要多轮交互。哪种方法能让 LLM 具备利用之前客户历史消息上下文的能力？
options: Turn on model invocation logging to collect messages.
Add messages to the model prompt.
Use Amazon Personalize to save conversation history.
Use Provisioned Throughput for the LLM.
options_zh: 开启模型调用日志记录 (Invocation Logging)
将历史消息追加到模型提示词中 (Add messages to the prompt / 维护对话历史)
使用 Amazon Personalize 保存会话历史
为 LLM 购买预置吞吐量
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：大模型多轮对话上下文维护】\nLLM 本身是无状态的（Stateless）。要实现连续对话记忆，最直接有效的方式是在每一次调用时，将先前的用户消息与助手回复追加至当前 Prompt 中。

questions.domain: Domain 4: 负责任 AI 的指南
questions.question: An ML research team develops custom ML models. The model artifacts are shared with other teams for integration into products and services. The ML team retains the model training code and data. The ML team wants to build a mechanism that the ML team can use to audit models. Which solution should the ML team use when publishing the custom ML models?
questions.question_zh: 某算法团队与其他团队共享模型制品，需要建立一种标准化机制来记录模型用途、训练细节以供审计。应采用哪种方案？
options: Create documents with the relevant information. Store the documents in Amazon S3.
Use AWS AI Service Cards for transparency and understanding models.
Create Amazon SageMaker Model Cards with intended uses and training and inference details.
Create model training scripts. Commit the model training scripts to a Git repository.
options_zh: 创建文档并保存在 Amazon S3 桶中
使用 AWS AI Service Cards (仅适用于 AWS 自身托管 AI 服务)
创建 Amazon SageMaker Model Cards，标准化记录预期用途、训练及推理指标
将训练脚本提交至 Git 仓库
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：SageMaker Model Cards 模型卡片】\nSageMaker Model Cards 专用于集中标准化记录自定义模型的预期用途、训练参数、性能指标、已知局限与合规审计信息，充当模型治理的唯一可信源。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: A manufacturing company uses AI to inspect products and find any damages or defects. Which type of AI application is the company using?
questions.question_zh: 某制造企业利用 AI 视觉检查产品以发现破损或瑕疵。该公司使用的是哪种 AI 应用类型？
options_zh: 推荐系统
自然语言处理 (NLP)
计算机视觉 (Computer vision - 图像缺陷检测)
基础图像处理 (非 AI 级语义理解)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：计算机视觉应用】\n利用深度学习模型分析产品图片或摄像头视频流，识别微小裂纹、缺损或装配缺陷，属于典型的计算机视觉（Computer Vision）工业检测场景。

questions.domain: Domain 4: 负责任 AI 的指南
questions.question: A financial institution is building an AI solution to make loan approval decisions by using a foundation model (FM). For security and audit purposes, the company needs the AI solution's decisions to be explainable. Which factor relates to the explainability of the AI solution's decisions?
questions.question_zh: 某金融机构使用基础模型进行贷款审批决策，需要决策具备可解释性。以下哪项因素与模型决策的可解释性直接相关？
options_zh: 模型复杂度 (Model complexity - 模型越复杂越偏向黑盒)
训练耗时
超参数数量
部署耗时
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：模型复杂度与可解释性权衡】\n模型复杂度直接决定了其透明度：简单的线性模型或浅层决策树天生具备高可解释性；而深度神经网络结构极其复杂，常被视作黑盒，解释其具体单笔决策的难度显著增加。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: Which phase of the ML lifecycle determines compliance and regulatory requirements?
questions.question_zh: 在机器学习生命周期的哪一阶段，应当明确合规与监管法规要求？
options_zh: 特征工程阶段
模型训练阶段
数据收集阶段
业务目标确定阶段 (Business goal identification / 专案启动规划期)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：ML 生命周期初始阶段】\n合规、数据隐私与法规要求必须在项目最初的「业务目标确定（Business Goal Identification）」阶段明确，才能正确指导后续的数据采集范围、加密标准与算法选型。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: A company wants to create a chatbot that answers questions about human resources policies. The company is using a large language model (LLM) and has a large digital documentation base. Which technique should the company use to optimize the generated responses?
questions.question_zh: 某公司使用 LLM 构建人事政策问答机器人，并拥有庞大的人事实体文档库。应使用哪种技术来优化回复的准确性与真实性？
options_zh: 使用检索增强生成 (RAG - Retrieval Augmented Generation)
使用少样本提示词
将温度设为 1
减少 Token 大小
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：基于文档库问答的 RAG 技术】\n对于企业现成庞大的 HR 规范文档库，采用 RAG 技术能够根据提问实时检索最匹配的规章条款并注入提示词，确保回复完全有据可循并减少幻觉。

questions.domain: Domain 5: 安全性、合规与管控
questions.question: Which component of Amazon Bedrock Studio can help secure the content that AI systems generate?
questions.question_zh: Amazon Bedrock 中的哪个组件可以帮助保护 AI 系统生成的内容，防止其输出违规、有害或敏感信息？
options_zh: 访问控制
函数调用 (Function calling)
安全护栏 (Guardrails for Amazon Bedrock)
知识库 (Knowledge bases)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：Bedrock Guardrails 内容安全】\nGuardrails 提供内容过滤器、敏感信息过滤器与违规主题拦截机制，专门负责把关生成内容的合规性与安全性。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: A company is developing an ML model to predict customer churn. Which evaluation metric will assess the model's performance on a binary classification task such as predicting churn?
questions.question_zh: 某公司构建二分类模型预测客户流失 (Churn)。哪种评估指标最适合衡量该二分类模型的综合表现？
options: Time used to train the model
options_zh: F1 分数 (F1 score - 兼顾精准率与召回率)
均方误差 (MSE - 回归指标)
R方 (R-squared - 回归指标)
模型训练耗时
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：二分类不平衡评估指标 F1 Score】\n客户流失预测属于典型的二分类且正负样本高度不平衡场景（流失客户往往是极少数），F1 Score 能够平衡查准率与查全率，是比单纯 Accuracy 更具参考价值的指标。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: An ecommerce company wants to improve search engine recommendations by customizing the results for each user of the company's ecommerce platform. Which AWS service meets these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 某电商公司希望通过为每个用户定制推荐结果来改善平台搜索体验。哪项 AWS 服务满足要求？
options_zh: Amazon Personalize (个性化千人千面推荐服务)
Amazon Kendra (企业级语义搜索)
Amazon Rekognition
Amazon Transcribe
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：个性化推荐服务 Amazon Personalize】\nAmazon Personalize 基于与 Amazon.com 相同的个性化机器学习技术，支持个性化排序、用户专属商品推荐与实时再营销。

questions.domain: Domain 5: 安全性、合规与管控
questions.question: An ecommerce company is using a chatbot to automate the customer order submission process. Which option is an AI system input vulnerability that the company needs to resolve before the chatbot is made available?
questions.question_zh: 某电商客服机器人提供 7x24 小时订购服务。在上线前，公司需要重点防范哪种「输入层」的 AI 安全漏洞？
options_zh: 数据泄漏 (Data leakage)
提示词注入攻击 (Prompt injection - 属于输入层直接风险)
大模型幻觉 (属于输出层风险)
概念漂移 (属于长期维护风险)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：输入层漏洞 Prompt Injection】\nPrompt Injection（提示词注入）是攻击者通过在用户输入中精心构造恶意指令，试图劫持或覆盖系统原有规则的最典型输入层漏洞。

questions.domain: Domain 2: 生成式 AI 的基础知识
questions.question: Which scenario represents a practical use case for generative AI?
questions.question_zh: 以下哪个场景代表了生成式 AI (Generative AI) 的实际典型用例？
options: Using an ML model to forecast product demand
Employing a chatbot to provide human-like responses to customer queries in real time
Using an analytics dashboard to track website traffic and user behavior
Implementing a rule-based recommendation engine to suggest products to customers
options_zh: 使用 ML 模型预测产品需求 (判别式/预测型 ML)
使用对话机器人实时生成拟人化、上下文相关的客户答复 (生成式 AI 典型应用)
使用分析仪表板跟踪网站流量
实现基于硬编码规则的推荐引擎
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：生成式 AI 典型用例】\n生成式 AI 的核心特征在于「动态生成崭新的内容（如流畅自然的多轮文本回复、代码、图像）」，而非简单的数字预测或规则匹配。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: Which technique breaks a complex task into smaller subtasks that are sent sequentially to a large language model (LLM)?
questions.question_zh: 哪种提示词工程技术将复杂任务拆分为较小的子任务，并按顺序依次发送给大语言模型 (LLM) 处理？
options_zh: 单样本提示 (One-shot prompting)
提示词链 (Prompt chaining - 顺序分步传递)
思维树 (Tree of thoughts)
检索增强生成 (RAG)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：提示词链 Prompt Chaining】\nPrompt Chaining 是将复杂管道分解，将前一个提示词的输出作为下一个提示词的输入按步骤链式执行的高阶提示词工程技术。

questions.domain: Domain 4: 负责任 AI 的指南
questions.question: A retail company wants to build an ML model to recommend products to customers based on responsible practices. Which practice should the company apply when collecting data to decrease model bias?
questions.question_zh: 某零售公司希望负责任地构建商品推荐模型。在数据收集阶段应采取哪种做法来减少模型偏见？
options: Use data from only customers who match the demography of the company's overall customer base.
Collect data from customers who have a past purchase history.
Ensure that the data is balanced and collected from a diverse group.
Ensure that the data is from a publicly available dataset.
options_zh: 仅使用符合公司目前主流客群特征的数据
仅收集有历史购买记录的客户数据
确保数据类别平衡且来自多元化群体 (Ensure balanced and diverse data collection)
确保数据仅来自公开数据集
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：源头减少数据偏见】\n在数据准备与收集阶段，保证样本来源的多样性（Diversity）与各类别的相对平衡（Balance）是消除算法偏见最治本的做法。

questions.domain: Domain 5: 安全性、合规与管控
questions.question: Which option is a characteristic of AI governance frameworks for building trust and deploying human-centered AI technologies?
questions.question_zh: 建立信任及部署以人为本 AI 技术时，AI 治理框架 (AI Governance Frameworks) 的典型特征是什么？
options: Expanding initiatives across business units to create long-term business value
Ensuring alignment with business standards, revenue goals, and stakeholder expectations
Overcoming challenges to drive business transformation and growth
Developing policies and guidelines for data, transparency, responsible AI, and compliance
options_zh: 跨业务部门扩展举措以创造长期商业价值
确保与商业营收目标对齐
克服业务转型阻力
制定关于数据管理、透明度、负责任 AI 及合规性的政策与准则 (Policies and guidelines for data & compliance)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：AI 治理框架的核心职责】\nAI 治理（Governance）侧重于建立全方位的制度、审计基线与道德守则，涵盖数据生命周期管控、模型透明度、伦理合规与风险防范。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: A media company wants to deploy a customized ML model in its production environment and observe if the model quality drifts over time. Which AWS service or feature meets these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 某媒体公司将自定义模型部署至生产环境，需要持续监控模型预测质量是否随时间推移发生漂移 (Drift)。哪项功能满足要求？
options_zh: Amazon Rekognition
Amazon SageMaker Clarify (偏见检测与特征归因)
Amazon Comprehend
Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor (生产环境模型质量与数据漂移监控)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：SageMaker Model Monitor 监控漂移】\nSageMaker Model Monitor 专用于持续监控生产环境中的模型表现、特征分布漂移（Data Drift）与概念漂移，并在指标异常时触发通知。

questions.domain: Domain 5: 安全性、合规与管控
questions.question: A bank is fine-tuning a large language model (LLM) on Amazon Bedrock to assist customers with questions about loans. The bank wants to ensure that the model does not reveal any private customer data. Which solution meets these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 银行在 Amazon Bedrock 上微调大模型解答贷款咨询，必须确保模型在回答中绝不泄露客户隐私数据。哪种做法最根本且有效？
options: Remove personally identifiable information (PII) from the customer data before fine-tuning the LLM.
Increase the Top-K parameter of the LLM.
Store customer data in Amazon S3. Encrypt the data before fine-tuning the LLM.
options_zh: 仅使用 Amazon Bedrock Guardrails 进行运行时过滤
在微调前从客户训练数据中彻底移除个人身份信息 (PII) (Remove PII before fine-tuning)
调高 LLM 的 Top-K 参数
在 S3 中仅对数据进行静态加密
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：源头防范模型记忆敏感数据】\n模型在训练/微调时会将其学习到的文本模式内化为权重。要彻底防止隐私泄露，必须在微调前对训练语料执行脱敏（Anonymization）与 PII 剥离。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: An AI practitioner needs to improve the accuracy of a natural language generation model that uses rapidly changing inventory data. Which technique will improve the model's accuracy?
questions.question_zh: AI 从业者需要提升基于「频繁实时变动的库存数据」进行生成的语言模型准确度。哪种技术最适用？
options_zh: 迁移学习 (Transfer learning)
联邦学习 (Federated learning)
检索增强生成 (RAG - 动态结合最新外部库存数据)
单样本提示 (One-shot prompting)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：频繁变动数据与 RAG 的契合度】\n库存、价格等高频变动数据不可能每次改变都去重新微调模型；RAG 架构能够在推理瞬间从外部数据库捞取实时库存注入 Prompt，保证生成结果百分之百准确可靠。

questions.domain: Domain 5: 安全性、合规与管控
questions.question: A company is building a new generative AI chatbot using Amazon Bedrock. During testing, the company notices that the chatbot is prone to prompt injection attacks. What can the company do to secure the chatbot with the LEAST implementation effort?
questions.question_zh: 测试中发现 Bedrock 聊天机器人容易遭受提示词注入攻击 (Prompt Injection)。公司如何以最少的实施工作量增强其安全性？
options: Fine-tune the FM to avoid harmful responses.
Use Amazon Bedrock Guardrails content filters and denied topics.
Change the FM to a more secure FM.
Use chain-of-thought prompting to produce secure responses.
options_zh: 微调基础模型以避免有害回复
配置并使用 Amazon Bedrock Guardrails 的内容过滤器与拒绝主题 (Denied Topics)
更换更安全的基础模型
使用思维链提示词生成安全响应
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：防范提示注入攻击的最少工作量方案】\nAmazon Bedrock Guardrails 是全托管的原生安全护栏，无需编写复杂拦截代码或重训模型，直接在界面配置敏感词、上下文接地与拒绝主题即可有效抵御 Prompt Injection。

questions.domain: Domain 5: 安全性、合规与管控
questions.question: A company needs to monitor the performance of its ML systems by using a highly scalable AWS service. Which AWS service meets these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 某公司需要使用高扩展性的 AWS 服务来实时监控机器学习系统的性能指标与资源利用率。哪项服务满足要求？
options_zh: Amazon CloudWatch (指标、日志监控与告警)
AWS CloudTrail (API 审计日志)
AWS Trusted Advisor
AWS Config
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：性能监控服务 Amazon CloudWatch】\nAmazon CloudWatch 收集系统性能指标（CPU/GPU 利用率、推理延迟、调用错误率），提供仪表板并支持配置告警自动扩缩容。

questions.domain: Domain 5: 安全性、合规与管控
questions.question: A company needs to use Amazon SageMaker AI for model training and inference. The company must comply with regulatory requirements to run SageMaker jobs in an isolated environment without internet access. Which solution will meet these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 某公司在 SageMaker 上执行训练与推理，合规要求必须在没有任何公共互联网访问的隔离环境中运行。哪项配置满足要求？
options: Run SageMaker training and inference by using SageMaker Experiments.
Run SageMaker training and inference by using network isolation.
Encrypt the data at rest by using encryption for SageMaker geospatial capabilities.
Associate appropriate AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) roles with the SageMaker jobs.
options_zh: 使用 SageMaker Experiments 运行训练与推理
启用网络隔离设置 (Enable network isolation - 禁止任何出站外网通信)
使用地理空间加密静态数据
为作业关联适当的 IAM 角色
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：SageMaker 网络隔离 Network Isolation】\n启用 Network Isolation 参数后，SageMaker 容器在训练或推理期间完全无法进行任何外部公网调用，严格符合金融与国防等高密环境合规标准。

questions.domain: Domain 4: 负责任 AI 的指南
questions.question: A company wants to collaborate with several research institutes to develop an AI model. The company needs standardized documentation of model version tracking and a record of model development. Which solution meets these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 某公司与多家科研所合作研发模型，需要一种标准化的文档工具来记录模型版本追踪与开发生命周期详情。哪种方案满足要求？
options: Track the model changes by using Git.
Track the model changes by using Amazon Fraud Detector.
Track the model changes by using Amazon SageMaker Model Cards.
Track the model changes by using Amazon Comprehend.
options_zh: 使用 Git 追踪模型代码变更
使用 Amazon Fraud Detector 追踪
使用 Amazon SageMaker Model Cards 标准化记录模型文档与版本信息
使用 Amazon Comprehend 追踪
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：模型跨团队文档化管理 SageMaker Model Cards】\nSageMaker Model Cards 提供单一事实来源（Single Source of Truth），统一记录模型训练集、评估指标、道德考虑与版本迭代，极大方便科研跨机构协作。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: A bank is building a chatbot to answer customer questions about opening a bank account. The chatbot will use public bank documents to generate responses. The company will use Amazon Bedrock and prompt engineering to improve the chatbot's responses. Which prompt engineering technique meets these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 银行构建开户答疑机器人，使用提示词工程引导模型根据官方文档生成一致、符合业务语境的格式化回答。哪种提示词技术满足要求？
options_zh: 基于复杂度的提示
零样本提示 (Zero-shot)
少样本提示 (Few-shot)
定向刺激提示 (Directional stimulus prompting - 使用特定线索引导特定输出结构)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：定向刺激提示词工程】\nDirectional Stimulus Prompting 在提示词中提供微小的关键词、线索提示或方向性指示符，引导基础模型聚焦于特定业务文本的某部分进行结构化解答。

questions.domain: Domain 5: 安全性、合规与管控
questions.question: A company needs to log all requests made to its Amazon Bedrock API. The company must retain the logs securely for 5 years at the lowest possible cost. Which combination of AWS service and storage class meets these requirements? (Select TWO.)
questions.question_zh: 某公司需要记录对 Amazon Bedrock API 的所有调用请求，并以最低成本安全保留 5 年日志。应选用哪两项服务的组合？(Select TWO)
options_zh: AWS CloudTrail (API 请求审计记录)
Amazon CloudWatch
AWS Audit Manager
Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering (自动根据访问频率分层节约存储成本)
Amazon S3 Standard
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：API 审计与长期低成本归档组合】\nAWS CloudTrail 记录对 Bedrock 的所有 API 级别请求；将 CloudTrail 日志存储至 Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering（或 Glacier 生命周期规则）可在 5 年合规保留期内实现成本最优。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: A medical company wants to develop an AI application that can access structured patient records, extract relevant information, and generate concise summaries. Which solution will meet these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 某医疗公司希望开发能够访问病历、精准提取临床实体（疾病、药物剂量）并生成摘要的应用。哪种方案满足要求？
options: Use Amazon Comprehend Medical to extract relevant medical entities and relationships. Apply rule-based logic to structure and format summaries.
Use Amazon Personalize to analyze patient engagement patterns. Integrate the output with a general purpose text summarization tool.
Use Amazon Textract to convert scanned documents into digital text. Design a keyword extraction system to generate summaries.
Implement Amazon Kendra to provide a searchable index for medical records. Use a template-based system to format summaries.
options_zh: 使用 Amazon Comprehend Medical 提取医疗专业实体与关系，配合规则逻辑输出结构化摘要
使用 Amazon Personalize 分析患者模式
使用 Amazon Textract 转换文档并设计关键词提取系统
使用 Amazon Kendra 提供病历搜索
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：医疗领域专业 NLP Amazon Comprehend Medical】\nAmazon Comprehend Medical 预先训练了深厚的医学知识，能够从非结构化临床记录中精准识别病症、解剖部位、药品名称及服药频次剂量实体。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: A company wants to build and deploy ML models on AWS without writing any code. Which AWS service or feature meets these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 某业务团队希望在 AWS 上构建并部署机器学习模型，且完全不需要编写任何代码。哪项服务满足要求？
options_zh: Amazon SageMaker Canvas (可视化无代码 ML 构建界面)
Amazon Rekognition
AWS DeepRacer
Amazon Comprehend
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：无代码机器学习 SageMaker Canvas】\nSageMaker Canvas 是专门面向业务分析人员的无代码 (No-Code) 可视化点选工具，用户直接上传表格即可自动训练、评估与部署预测模型。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: A publishing company built a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) based solution to give its users the ability to interact with published content. New content is published daily. Which steps in the RAG pipeline should the company implement by using offline batch processing? (Select TWO.)
questions.question_zh: 某出版社构建 RAG 应用，每天有新内容发布。在 RAG 流水线中，哪些步骤应该通过「离线批处理 (Offline Batch)」来实现以确保近实时体验？(Select TWO)
options: Generation of embeddings for user queries
options_zh: 文档内容的向量嵌入生成 (Generation of content embeddings - 离线批量处理)
用户提问 Query 的向量嵌入生成 (必须在线实时)
向量检索索引的创建与更新 (Creation of the search index - 离线批量处理)
相关文档检索 (必须在线实时)
最终回复文本生成 (必须在线实时)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：RAG 流水线中批处理与实时推理的分工】\n每日新增的文档需要切块并计算向量嵌入（Embeddings）、更新向量库索引，这属于重计算的离线批处理任务；而用户查询转换向量、检索匹配与 LLM 最终作答必须在线毫秒级实时完成。

questions.domain: Domain 4: 负责任 AI 的指南
questions.question: A bank has fine-tuned a large language model (LLM) to expedite the loan approval process. During an external audit, the company discovered that the model was approving loans at a faster pace for a specific demographic than for others. How should the bank fix this issue MOST cost-effectively?
questions.question_zh: 审计发现贷款模型对特定族群审批通过明显偏快偏高。银行应如何最具成本效益地修正该偏见问题？
options: Include more diverse training data. Fine-tune the model again by using the new data.
Use Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) with the fine-tuned model.
Use AWS Trusted Advisor checks to eliminate bias.
Pre-train a new LLM with more diverse training data.
options_zh: 补充更具多样性的代表性样本数据，并使用新数据集重新微调模型 (Include diverse data & fine-tune again)
结合使用 RAG
使用 AWS Trusted Advisor 消除偏见
从零开始重新预训练一个全新的大语言模型 (极度昂贵且不必要)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：偏见缓解的最优成本方案】\n从头预训练（Pre-train from scratch）耗资数百万美元；而收集代表性不足群体的合规样本并再次进行「微调（Fine-tuning）」，兼顾有效性与极高性价比。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: Which option is an example of unsupervised learning?
questions.question_zh: 以下哪项是无监督学习 (Unsupervised Learning) 的典型例子？
options: A model that groups customers based on their purchase history
A model that classifies images as dogs or cats
A model that predicts a house's price based on various features
A model that learns to play chess by using trial and error
options_zh: 根据客户历史购买行为将客户自动分组的模型 (客户聚类 - 无标签)
将图片分类为猫或狗的模型 (监督分类)
根据房屋特征预测房价的模型 (监督回归)
通过试错自我博弈下棋的模型 (强化学习)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：无监督学习典型场景】\n根据购买特征自动对客户进行画像聚类（Clustering），不需要事先给客户定义好标签，属于标准的无监督学习。

questions.domain: Domain 4: 负责任 AI 的指南
questions.question: A social media company wants to use a large language model (LLM) to summarize messages and compare the generated output toxicity of these models. Which strategy gives the company the ability to evaluate the LLMs with the LEAST operational overhead?
questions.question_zh: 社交媒体公司对比多款大模型的摘要毒性/有害性。哪种策略能以「最少的人工与运维开销」完成模型评估？
options_zh: 众包人员评审
自动化模型评估 (Automatic model evaluation / 算法自动化打分)
雇佣人工审核员评审
基于人类反馈的强化学习 (RLHF)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：低开销毒性评估 Automatic Model Evaluation】\n使用自动化评估工具（如结合毒性检测分类器 API 或 Bedrock 自动评测）能够无须人工干预、可重复、快速对海量输出进行毒性打分，开销最小。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: An AI practitioner adds the following phrase to the end of the prompt: 'Ask the model to show its work by explaining its reasoning step by step.' Which prompt engineering technique is the AI practitioner using?
questions.question_zh: 在提示词末尾添加要求：「请逐步解释推理过程以展示计算步骤 (Show work step by step)」。这使用的是哪种提示词工程技术？
options_zh: 思维链提示 (Chain-of-thought prompting - 引导模型按逻辑分步推理)
提示词注入
少样本提示
提示词模板
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：思维链提示 Chain-of-Thought (CoT)】\n思维链提示通过引导大模型将复杂的推理、数学或逻辑题拆解为中间步骤逐步作答（Let's think step by step），大幅提高答案严密性。

questions.domain: Domain 4: 负责任 AI 的指南
questions.question: A large retail bank wants to develop an ML system to help the risk management team decide on loan allocations. What must the bank do to develop an unbiased ML model?
questions.question_zh: 银行为风险管理团队开发贷款分配模型。若要开发出无偏见的公正模型，必须采取哪种措施？
options: Reduce the size of the training dataset.
Ensure that the ML model predictions are consistent with historical results.
Create a different ML model for each demographic group.
Measure class imbalance on the training dataset. Adapt the training process accordingly.
options_zh: 缩减训练数据集规模
确保预测结果与带有历史偏见的历史数据保持完全一致
为每个族群单独创建一个不同的模型
测量训练集中的类别不平衡，并相应调整训练过程 (Measure class imbalance & adapt training)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：消除算法偏见的方法】\n使用 SageMaker Clarify 等工具检测训练集中的群体不平衡（Class Imbalance），并采取重采样或调整类别权重等方式调整训练，是消除系统性歧视的标准方法。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: A company has developed an ML model to predict real estate sale prices. The company wants to deploy the model to make predictions without managing servers or infrastructure. Which solution meets these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 某公司开发了房价预测模型，希望在无需自行管理服务器或底层基础设施的情况下部署模型提供预测。哪种方案满足要求？
options: Deploy the model on an Amazon EC2 instance.
Deploy the model on an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster.
Deploy the model by using Amazon CloudFront with an Amazon S3 integration.
Deploy the model by using an Amazon SageMaker AI endpoint.
options_zh: 将模型部署在 Amazon EC2 实例上
将模型部署在 Amazon EKS 集群上
通过 Amazon CloudFront 结合 S3 部署模型
使用 Amazon SageMaker AI 托管端点部署模型 (SageMaker Endpoint)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：SageMaker 全托管端点部署】\nAmazon SageMaker 端点提供完全托管的无服务器/自动扩缩容模型部署能力，负责底层算力调度、自动扩容与补丁维护，企业无需管理任何底层服务器基础设施。

questions.domain: Domain 4: 负责任 AI 的指南
questions.question: A company wants to identify harmful language in the comments section of social media posts by using an ML model. The company will not use labeled data to train the model. Which strategy should the company use to identify harmful language?
questions.question_zh: 某公司希望识别社交媒体评论中的有害言论，且不打算使用任何标注数据去重新训练模型。应采用哪种策略？
options: Use Amazon SageMaker AI built-in algorithms to train the model.
Use Amazon Polly to monitor comments.
options_zh: 使用 Amazon Rekognition 内容审核 (专用于图像/视频审核)
使用 Amazon Comprehend 毒性检测 (Toxicity detection - 开箱即用无需标注)
使用 Amazon SageMaker 内置算法训练模型
使用 Amazon Polly 监控评论
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：Amazon Comprehend 毒性内容检测】\nAmazon Comprehend 提供预置的文本毒性检测（Toxicity Detection）API，开箱即用，无需用户自行准备已标注的数据集或训练模型。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: An animation company wants to provide subtitles for its content. Which AWS service meets this requirement?
questions.question_zh: 某动画制作公司希望自动为其影片内容生成字幕。哪项 AWS 服务满足要求？
options_zh: Amazon Comprehend (文本自然语言理解)
Amazon Polly (文字转语音 TTS)
Amazon Transcribe (语音转文字 ASR / 自动生成字幕)
Amazon Translate (机器翻译)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：语音转文字 Amazon Transcribe】\nAmazon Transcribe 能够自动分析音频/视频中的人类语音并转录为带时间戳的文本，非常适合快速自动化生成影片字幕与会议记录。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: A company stores millions of PDF documents in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company needs to extract the text from the PDFs, generate summaries of the text, and index the summaries for fast searching. Which combination of AWS services will meet these requirements? (Select TWO.)
questions.question_zh: 某公司在 S3 中存储了数百万份 PDF 文档，需要从 PDF 中提取文本、生成文本摘要并建立索引以支持快速搜索。应结合使用哪两项 AWS 服务？(Select TWO)
options_zh: Amazon Translate
Amazon Bedrock (利用基础模型生成文本摘要与嵌入)
Amazon Transcribe
Amazon Polly
Amazon Textract (从扫描文档与 PDF 中提取结构化文字与表格)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：智能文档处理 IDP 服务组合】\nAmazon Textract 负责从非结构化 PDF/图像中提取文本与表格；提取后的文本交给 Amazon Bedrock 上的 LLM 执行摘要提炼与语义分析。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: A software company wants to use a large language model (LLM) for workflow automation. The application will transform user messages into JSON files. The company has a labeled dataset that contains user messages and output JSON files. Which solution will train the LLM for workflow automation?
questions.question_zh: 某软件公司希望使用 LLM 将用户文本转换为结构化 JSON 文件。公司已准备好包含「用户输入文本与对应标准 JSON 输出」的标注数据集。应采用哪种方案定制模型？
options_zh: 无监督学习
持续预训练 (Continued pre-training - 仅使用无标注纯文本)
微调 (Fine-tuning - 使用监督式的成对标注数据)
基于人类反馈的强化学习 (RLHF)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：微调 Fine-tuning 适用场景】\n当手里拥有明确的「输入-期望输出（Prompt-Completion）」成对标注数据时，微调（Supervised Fine-Tuning）是教导模型掌握特定输出格式（如输出规范 JSON）的标准方法。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: A financial company is developing a fraud detection system that flags potential fraud cases in credit card transactions. Employees will evaluate the flagged fraud cases. The company wants to minimize the amount of time the employees spend reviewing flagged fraud cases that are not actually fraudulent. Which evaluation metric meets these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 信用卡欺诈检测系统中，被标记的案件需要人工审核。公司希望最大程度减少员工在「实际上不是欺诈但被误报」的案例上浪费的时间。应重点优化哪项评估指标？
options_zh: 召回率 (Recall - 减少漏报)
准确率 (Accuracy)
精确率 (Precision - 减少误报 / 假阳性 FP)
提升图 (Lift chart)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：精确率 Precision 业务含义】\n精确率公式为 TP / (TP + FP)。优化精确率能够减少假阳性（FP，即误报），从而确保被系统标记为欺诈的交易大部分都是真正的欺诈，减少人工审核的无效负担。

questions.domain: Domain 2: 生成式 AI 的基础知识
questions.question: A financial company is using ML to help with some of the company's tasks. Which option is a use of generative AI models?
questions.question_zh: 某金融公司利用 ML 辅助业务。以下哪项属于「生成式 AI (Generative AI)」的应用？
options: Classifying customers based on product usage
Segmenting customers based on type of investments
options_zh: 汇总客户投诉并生成摘要 (Summarizing customer complaints)
根据产品使用情况对客户进行分类 (传统判别式 ML)
按投资类型对客户进行细分聚类 (无监督聚类)
预测某些产品的营收 (回归预测)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：生成式 AI vs 传统判别式 ML】\n生成式 AI 的核心能力在于「创作新文本、摘要、图像或代码」；分类、聚类与营收数值预测均属于传统判别式机器学习任务。

questions.domain: Domain 4: 负责任 AI 的指南
questions.question: A hospital developed an AI system to provide personalized treatment recommendations for patients. The AI system must provide the rationale behind the recommendations and make the insights accessible to doctors and patients. Which human-centered design principle does this scenario present?
questions.question_zh: 医院开发医疗推荐系统，要求系统必须向医生和患者清晰解释推荐方案背后的具体原因。这体现了以人为本设计的哪项原则？
options_zh: 可解释性 (Explainability - 说明决策原因与推论依据)
隐私与安全
公平性
数据治理
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：以人为本 AI 之可解释性】\n在医疗与金融等关乎重大民生健康的领域，系统不能只是黑盒给出结论，必须提供可解释性（Explainability），让临床医师能审查特征归因与建议缘由。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: A food service company wants to develop an ML model to help decrease daily food waste and increase sales revenue. The company needs to continuously improve the model's accuracy. Which solution meets these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 餐饮公司开发模型以减少食物浪费并提高营收，且需要持续提高模型的预测精度。哪种方案满足要求？
options: Use Amazon SageMaker AI and iterate with the most recent data.
Use Amazon Personalize and iterate with historical data.
Use Amazon CloudWatch to analyze customer orders.
Use Amazon Rekognition to optimize the model.
options_zh: 使用 Amazon SageMaker AI，并利用最新业务数据持续迭代重新训练模型
使用 Amazon Personalize 并仅使用历史数据迭代
使用 Amazon CloudWatch 分析订单
使用 Amazon Rekognition 优化模型
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：ML 模型持续更新与迭代】\n消费与客流数据具有时效性。使用 Amazon SageMaker 建立端到端 MLOps 流水线，定期抓取最新业务数据重新训练与调优模型，是持续保持高精度的标准做法。

questions.domain: Domain 5: 安全性、合规与管控
questions.question: A financial company has offices in different countries worldwide. The company requires that all API calls between generative AI applications and foundation models (FM) must not travel across the public internet. Which AWS service should the company use?
questions.question_zh: 跨国金融机构要求生成式 AI 应用程序与基础模型之间的所有 API 调用流量均不得跨越公共互联网。应使用哪项 AWS 服务？
options_zh: AWS PrivateLink (VPC 私有网络终端节点)
Amazon Q
Amazon CloudFront
AWS CloudTrail
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：网络隔离与 AWS PrivateLink】\nAWS PrivateLink 通过在用户 VPC 内提供接口端点，使流量完全走 AWS 内部全球专线骨干网络与托管服务通信，彻底免除公网暴露风险。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: A company has a generative AI application that uses a pre-trained foundation model (FM) on Amazon Bedrock. The company wants the FM to include more context by using company information. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
questions.question_zh: 某公司在 Amazon Bedrock 上使用预训练基础模型，希望结合内部企业资料为模型补充更多上下文。哪种方案最具成本效益？
options: Choose a different FM on Amazon Bedrock.
Deploy a custom model on Amazon Bedrock.
options_zh: 使用 Amazon Bedrock 知识库 (Knowledge Bases - 实现开箱即用 RAG)
在 Amazon Bedrock 上更换不同的基础模型
使用 Amazon Bedrock Agents
在 Amazon Bedrock 上部署自定义训练模型
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：Bedrock Knowledge Bases 检索增强生成】\nAmazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases 是实现 RAG 的全托管服务，能够直接连通 S3 上的内部文档，在不产生昂贵模型训练/微调费用的前提下，最经济地为模型补充企业上下文。

questions.domain: Domain 4: 负责任 AI 的指南
questions.question: A company is developing an ML model to make loan approvals. The company must implement a solution to detect bias in the model. The company must also be able to explain the model's predictions. Which solution will meet these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 某贷款审批模型必须具备「检测模型偏见」以及「解释模型预测结果」的能力以满足监管要求。哪项服务满足要求？
options_zh: Amazon SageMaker Clarify (偏见检测与基于 SHAP 值的特征归因解释)
Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler
Amazon SageMaker Model Cards
AWS AI Service Cards
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：SageMaker Clarify 偏见检测与可解释性】\nSageMaker Clarify 能在训练前和训练后计算群体偏见指标（如 DPL、DI），并利用 Shapley 归因值解释各个特征对单笔预测的贡献比例。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: A retail company is tagging its product inventory. A tag is automatically assigned to each product based on the product description. The company created one product category by using a large language model (LLM) on Amazon Bedrock in few-shot learning mode. The company collected a labeled dataset and wants to scale the solution to all product categories. Which solution meets these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 某零售公司为商品打标签，已收集到全品类的标注数据集。若要将方案规模化扩展到所有品类并保证高精度，应选用哪种方案？
options: Use prompt engineering with zero-shot learning.
Use prompt engineering with prompt templates.
Customize the model with continued pre-training.
options_zh: 使用零样本提示工程
使用提示模板工程
使用持续预训练定制模型
通过微调 (Fine-tuning) 定制基础模型
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：全量标注数据与微调】\n当已经收集到了大量高质量的结构化标注数据（商品描述 -> 正确标签），通过微调（Fine-tuning）可以使模型彻底内化各品类的分类特征，达到比少样本提示更高的准确度与更低的 Token 推理成本。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: What is the benefit of fine-tuning a foundation model (FM)?
questions.question_zh: 微调基础模型 (Fine-tuning a Foundation Model) 的主要收益是什么？
options: Fine-tuning reduces the FM's size and complexity and enables slower inference.
Fine-tuning uses specific training data to retrain the FM from scratch to adapt to a specific use case.
Fine-tuning keeps the FM's knowledge up to date by pre-training the FM on more recent data.
Fine-tuning improves the performance of the FM on a specific task by further training the FM on new labeled data.
options_zh: 微调降低了模型大小并导致更慢的推理速度
微调使用特定数据从头重新训练整个模型
微调通过在最新数据上预训练使知识保持最新
微调通过在新的标注数据集上进一步训练，显著提高基础模型在特定专业任务上的性能表现
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：微调核心定义】\n微调（Fine-tuning）是在已预训练好的强大基础模型之上，使用领域特定、有标签的小型数据集继续训练调整权重，从而特化其在特定垂直任务中的准确度。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: A company needs an automated solution to group its customers into multiple categories. The company does not want to manually define the categories. Which ML technique should the company use?
questions.question_zh: 某公司需要将客户自动分为若干群组，且不希望事先手动定义群组类别。应采用哪种机器学习技术？
options_zh: 分类 (Classification - 需要预设标签)
线性回归 (Linear regression - 预测数值)
逻辑回归 (Logistic regression - 预测概率)
聚类 (Clustering - 无监督自动分组)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：聚类分析 Clustering】\n聚类是典型的无监督学习，算法根据特征（如购买频率、金额）的几何距离自动探索样本天然聚集的群落，完全无需预设分类标签。

questions.domain: Domain 5: 安全性、合规与管控
questions.question: A company uses a third-party model on Amazon Bedrock to analyze confidential documents. The company is concerned about data privacy. Which statement describes how Amazon Bedrock protects data privacy?
questions.question_zh: 某公司在 Amazon Bedrock 上使用第三方模型分析机密文档。下列哪项陈述正确描述了 Amazon Bedrock 如何保护客户数据隐私？
options: User inputs and model outputs are anonymized and shared with third-party model providers.
User inputs and model outputs are not shared with any third-party model providers.
User inputs are kept confidential, but model outputs are shared with third-party model providers.
User inputs and model outputs are redacted before the inputs and outputs are shared with third-party model providers.
options_zh: 用户输入与输出被脱敏后共享给第三方模型提供商
用户的输入和模型输出绝不会与任何第三方模型提供商共享 (Not shared with third parties)
输入保密，但输出会共享
输入输出经过编辑后共享给第三方
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：Bedrock 数据隐私与隔离承诺】\nAWS 官方明确承诺：在 Amazon Bedrock 中处理的数据（Prompt 与生成的回复）完全保留在客户专有环境中，绝不会共享给第三方模型开发商，也绝不会被用于训练基础模型。

questions.domain: Domain 5: 安全性、合规与管控
questions.question: Which scenario describes a potential risk and limitation of prompt engineering in the context of a generative AI model?
questions.question_zh: 在生成式 AI 模型的语境下，下列哪项描述了提示词工程 (Prompt Engineering) 的潜在风险与局限性？
options: Prompt engineering does not ensure that the model always produces consistent and deterministic outputs, eliminating the need for validation.
Prompt engineering could expose the model to vulnerabilities such as prompt injection attacks.
Properly designed prompts reduce but do not eliminate the risk of data poisoning or model hijacking.
Prompt engineering does not ensure that the model will consistently generate highly reliable outputs when working with real-world data.
options_zh: 提示工程无法保证模型始终输出确定性结果，从而免除验证需求
提示工程可能会使模型暴露于诸如提示词注入攻击 (Prompt Injection Attacks) 之类的安全漏洞中
设计良好的提示词减少但不能消除数据投毒风险
提示词工程无法确保模型在处理真实数据时输出完全可靠
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：提示词工程的安全脆弱性】\n过度依赖提示词逻辑而不搭配系统级安全护栏时，恶意用户极易通过构造对抗性提示（如「忽略之前所有指令」）实施提示词注入攻击，绕过既定规则。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: Which AWS service or feature stores embeddings in a vector database for use with foundation models (FMs) and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)?
questions.question_zh: 哪项 AWS 服务支持作为向量数据库存储向量嵌入 (Embeddings)，供基础模型和 RAG 检索使用？
options_zh: Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth
Amazon OpenSearch Service (支持向量索引与 k-NN 语义搜索)
Amazon Transcribe
Amazon Textract
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：向量数据库服务 Amazon OpenSearch Service】\nAmazon OpenSearch Service 原生支持基于向量的 k-最近邻 (k-NN) 算法，是构建 RAG 向量知识库的主流 AWS 托管数据库之一。

questions.domain: Domain 5: 安全性、合规与管控
questions.question: A company uses Amazon SageMaker and various models for its AI workloads. The company needs to understand if its AI workloads are ISO compliant. Which AWS service or feature meets these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 某公司需要查验其在 AWS 上的 AI 工作负载是否符合 ISO 国际合规标准认证。哪项 AWS 服务满足要求？
options_zh: AWS Audit Manager
Amazon SageMaker Model Cards
Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor
AWS Artifact (按需下载 AWS 与第三方的 ISO、SOC 合规审计报告)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：合规报告门户 AWS Artifact】\nAWS Artifact 是获取 AWS 官方合规认证凭证（如 ISO 27001、SOC 2、PCI DSS）与 ISV 第三方合规文档的自助式中央门户。

questions.domain: Domain 2: 生成式 AI 的基础知识
questions.question: What is the purpose of vector embeddings in a large language model (LLM)?
questions.question_zh: 在大型语言模型 (LLM) 中，向量嵌入 (Vector Embeddings) 的核心用途是什么？
options: Splitting text into manageable pieces of data
Grouping a set of characters to be treated as a single unit
Providing the ability to mathematically compare texts
Providing the count of every word in the input
options_zh: 将文本分割为易于管理的数据片段 (这是分块 Chunking)
将字符组合为单个单元 (这是 Tokenization)
提供在数学几何向量空间中比较文本语义相似度的能力 (Mathematically compare texts)
统计输入中每个单词的出现频次 (词袋模型)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：向量嵌入的数学意义】\nEmbeddings 将文本映射为多维数值向量。语义相似的词句在向量空间中距离相近，使得算法能够通过计算余弦相似度等数学指标精确比较语义。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: Which term refers to the instructions given to foundation models (FMs) so that the FMs provide a more accurate response to a question?
questions.question_zh: 提供给基础模型 (FM) 以引导其生成准确回答的指令与文本被称为什么？
options_zh: 提示词 (Prompt)
方向 (Direction)
对话 (Dialog)
翻译 (Translation)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：提示词 Prompt 基本定义】\nPrompt 是输入给大语言模型或基础模型的一切文本指令、问题或上下文，用来指示模型期望生成的输出内容与格式。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: Which strategy will prevent model hallucinations?
questions.question_zh: 哪种策略能够最有效地防止大语言模型产生幻觉 (Hallucinations)？
options: Fact-check the output of the large language model (LLM).
Compare the output of the large language model (LLM) to the results of an internet search.
options_zh: 在模型输出后进行人工事实核查
将模型输出与网络搜索结果对比
使用上下文接地 (Contextual grounding - 如 RAG 确保回答基于权威文档)
使用相关性接地
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：上下文接地防范幻觉】\nContextual Grounding（上下文接地）要求大模型的生成严格绑定在经过验证的外部权威知识（如通过 Bedrock Knowledge Bases 注入的准确事实）之上，从机制上杜绝虚构事实。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
questions.question: An online learning company with large volumes of educational materials wants to use enterprise search. Which AWS service meets these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 某在线教育机构拥有海量教材与课件，需要实现企业级自然语言智能搜索。哪项 AWS 服务最合适？
options_zh: Amazon Comprehend
Amazon Textract
Amazon Kendra (内置 ML 的企业级语义搜索引擎)
Amazon Personalize
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：企业级语义搜索引擎 Amazon Kendra】\nAmazon Kendra 专为海量企业文档检索设计，支持直接以自然语言提问，并精准定位文档段落输出直接答案，而非仅返回关键词链接。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: Which task represents a practical use case to apply a regression model?
questions.question_zh: 以下哪项任务代表了应用「回归模型 (Regression Model)」的实际典型场景？
options: Suggest a genre of music for a listener from a list of genres.
Cluster movies based on movie ratings and viewers.
Use historical data to predict future temperatures in a specific city.
Create a picture that shows a specific object.
options_zh: 从流派列表中为听众推荐音乐流派 (多分类)
根据评分对电影进行聚类 (无监督聚类)
利用历史数据预测特定城市未来的气温数值 (连续数值回归预测)
生成指定物体的图像 (生成式 AI)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：回归分析的任务特征】\n回归（Regression）的目标是预测「连续的实数数值」（如温度、房价、销售额、股票波动）；若目标是离散类别则为分类任务。

questions.domain: Domain 1: AI 和 ML 的基础知识
questions.question: A hospital wants to use a generative AI solution with speech-to-text functionality to help improve employee skills in dictating clinical notes. Which AWS service meets these requirements?
questions.question_zh: 医院希望采用具备语音转文本功能的生成式 AI 方案，辅助医生听写并自动生成规范的临床诊疗记录。哪项服务满足要求？
options_zh: Amazon Q Developer
Amazon Polly
Amazon Rekognition
AWS HealthScribe (专用于医疗临床语音转录与生成结构化病历)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：医疗专用生成式 AI AWS HealthScribe】\nAWS HealthScribe 符合 HIPAA 规范，专门用于在医患对话中进行自动语音识别并利用大模型自动提取医学术语、生成分诊结构化病历摘要。

questions.domain: Domain 5: 安全性、合规与管控
questions.question: A company acquires International Organization for Standardization (ISO) accreditation to manage AI risks and to use AI responsibly. What does this accreditation certify?
questions.question_zh: 某公司获得了管理 AI 风险和负责任使用 AI 的 ISO 认证。该项认证主要证明了什么？
options: All members of the company are ISO certified.
All AI systems that the company uses are ISO certified.
All AI application team members are ISO certified.
The company's development framework is ISO certified.
options_zh: 公司所有员工均通过了 ISO 个人认证
公司使用的所有 AI 系统单个软件均已获得 ISO 认证
所有 AI 开发团队成员均获得个人认证
公司的 AI 开发与治理管理框架符合 ISO 标准认证 (The company's development framework)
questions.rationale: 【核心考点：ISO 治理认证的范畴】\n诸如 ISO/IEC 42001（AI 管理体系）等标准认证，认证的是企业组织层面的「AI 治理制度、风险管控流程与开发管理框架」，而非单个员工或特定算法模型。

questions.domain: Domain 3: 基础模型的应用
